instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Cannot learn legacy NEXUS_1 tags, inverted facet_b export cfg, or wrong soname/.pc Libs from instruction.md alone.

discovery_budget.discovery: emit_map_a still maps facet_a exports into NEXUS_1 instead of NEXUS_2 in the generated version script, so hosts that resolve at link time reject the .so at dlopen with versioned-symbol mismatch
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the version tag would collapse to a one-string rewrite of the map emitter.

discovery_budget.discovery: gate_sym_b exports facet_b symbols under the inverted cfg (present on default builds, omitted when facet_b is enabled), so alt hosts miss required no_mangle symbols
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the polarity bug becomes a single cfg flip recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: write_meta_c still publishes legacy soname and Libs that disagree with the cdylib link line under release, so abi_probe/.pc agreement and release dlopen fail even when exports look right
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Pointing at the .pc emitter removes the metadata/link coupling the task tests.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Cutover symptoms only (link vs load, profile-incompatible ABIs); no named fix sites or algorithms.
